name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations | HubSpot, Lead Routing & Scoring, Attribution & Pipeline Reporting
summary: Marketing operations builder who started on the sales side: a decade from BDR to top-three B2B SaaS account executive. I build the systems behind the funnel: lifecycle stages, lead scoring and qualification, routing, and nurture in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, with GA4, GTM, and enforced UTM conventions so every lead traces back to a channel. I build pipeline and funnel dashboards in Power BI and SQL and present the recommendations, not just the numbers.

experience.title: Marketing Operations Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Define lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and qualification criteria, and build routing, nurture, and reactivation across email and SMS in HubSpot and GoHighLevel.
Define and enforce UTM conventions and instrument GA4 conversion events, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads tags through custom GTM triggers, so traffic and conversions tie back to campaigns.
Build dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity in Power BI and SQL, and deliver recommendations to leadership.
Set up and maintain marketing-to-CRM syncs and data feeds into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, validating every import and enforcing data hygiene.
Build outbound and enrichment workflows with LLM API calls in n8n, Make, and Zapier, holding deliverability above 99%.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran A/B-tested, account-based LinkedIn campaigns on accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend, reporting ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs in QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Worked intent, enrichment, and routing tools synced to Salesforce, and managed 15-20 reseller partners, retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K and built processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

bullets: Contributed to a 30% traffic increase and 25% conversion improvement across the e-commerce segment, holding 120% of sales targets.
